tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be a Firm or Company registered in India. Joint Ventures and Consortiums are not allowed

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation
Others -- LLP Registration
Others -- Partnership Registration
Others -- GST Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have been in existence for a period of at least three (3) years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Certificate of Incorporation / LLP Registration / Partnership Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should be registered with the Commercial Tax Department for GST Should have filed the latest GST Returns.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration
Others -- GST Returns for the financial year FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be registered with Income Tax Department and should have filed the Income Tax Returns for the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of PAN
Others -- Income Tax Returns for the preceding three financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have an average annual turnover not less than Rs. 100 crores during the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number.
Others -- Audited Balance Sheet and Audited Profit & Loss Statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have an average annual turnover not less than Rs. 25 crores from Information Technology Consulting servicesduring the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certified copy from Chartered Accountant as per format given in the RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have positive net worth during any one of the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should have provided at least three (3) IT Consulting Services project/assignment of value not less than Rs. 20 lakhs for Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding three (3) financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase order / work order
Others -- End User Certificate / Work Completion certificate / Satisfactory Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have office in Bengaluru, Karnataka If the Applicant does not have an office in Bengaluru, the Applicant should submit an undertaking stating that they shall open an office in Bengaluru within 30 days of receipt of Letter of Indent / Notification of Award.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Telephone Bill / Electricity Bill / Lease Agreement in the name of applicant
Others -- Undertaking to open an office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be ISO 9001 certified in the area of IT Consulting services or related services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid ISO 9001 certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Affidavit as per format enclosed in RFP. Should be on Rs. 100 stamp paper and notarized.
